tools.name: viqton_capability_catalog
tools.description: List what VIQTON can run right now, with its limits (target, modes, spend cap, rate limits). Read-only.

tools.name: viqton_run_capability
tools.description: Run the public DNS capability through VIQTON. "normal": Cloudflare first, Google if it fails. "inject_primary_unavailable": simulate a Cloudflare outage and watch VIQTON hand over to Google (real query). "dual_observe": query both and cross-check. Read-only, fixed target example.com, $0. Requires co

tools.name: viqton_verify_receipt
tools.description: Check a receipt returned by viqton_run_capability: SHA-256 integrity, or the VIQTON self-signature when configured. Not an independent attestation.

tools.name: viqton_attest_outcome
tools.description: Send a receipt from viqton_run_capability to ResultBond's independent evaluator (policy rb.capability-outcome.v0.1). It re-queries public DNS itself and signs PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; VIQTON verifies that signature against a pinned evaluator key. Read-only.

tools.name: viqton_continuity
tools.description: VIQTON's latest Lumaion continuity proof (same identity across runtime changes, committed deployment/trust state preserved), verified offline. Read-only.

tools.name: viqton_runtime_trust
tools.description: What this runtime can and cannot prove: signing state, limits, and which integrations are not connected.
